title: The $9,000 watch that costs $27,000 today
description: The boutique refuses to sell you the watch and puts you on a five-year list. A private dealer across town has one in a safe right now, at three times the price. Follow the money through a single watch and the manufacturer turns out to collect none of it.

scenes.narration: The boutique will not sell you this watch. He will.
scenes.imagePrompt: Editorial hero macro of the crown side of a pristine stainless steel luxury sports watch resting on a hand-rubbed oiled walnut desk beside the edge of a closed brass-trimmed safe door, dramatic bright directional daylight raking across the fluted crown, ceramic bezel insert and polished lug facets, ultra-sharp product-photography detail on every knurl, screw and brushed surface, shallow depth of field melting into soft bokeh behind, only a sliver of the domed sapphire crystal edge visible at the frame border with the dial itself out of frame, a dark bronze safe panel filling the top third of the frame in shadow, magazine-quality still life lighting

scenes.narration: He is not the manufacturer, and he is not an authorized dealer. He is a private dealer with a safe.
scenes.imagePrompt: Architectural-digest-quality hero shot of a gleaming circular vault door standing half open in the discreet private office of an independent dealer, a polished chrome multi-bolt locking mechanism radiating outward with museum-grade precision from a brushed steel spoked wheel, thick engineered steel catching warm directional daylight in sharp mirror-like reflections, a book-matched dark marble floor reflecting the door, a cognac-leather wingback chair and an antique brass desk lamp glowing softly at the edge of the frame, deep mahogany panelling filling the top third of the frame in shadow, no people

scenes.narration: He bought it at the list price. The same price the boutique refused to take from you.
scenes.imagePrompt: Close-up looking straight down into a bespoke leather-lined presentation box with a hand-stitched espresso-dark suede interior, a coiled stainless steel luxury watch bracelet filling the box, bright daylight from a nearby window falling across the watch, the dark suede lid interior filling the top third of the frame in shadow, a dark walnut desk edge visible at the corner

scenes.narration: This afternoon, he sells it to you for three times that.
scenes.imagePrompt: Overhead shot of two identical open bespoke leather presentation boxes side by side on a dark grey book-matched marble surface, each cradling an elegant stainless steel luxury watch face-up, the domed sapphire crystals throwing a blinding sunburst reflection across each dial that washes out any numerals or text, brushed steel bracelets coiled around the cases, one watch lit warm and one lit cool under bright daylight, a solid dark bronze panel occupying the top third of the frame in shadow

scenes.narration: That premium is not a fee for the watch. It is a fee for skipping the queue.
scenes.imagePrompt: A velvet-lined watch tray on a hand-rubbed oiled oak desk holding one steel luxury watch face-down showing its polished caseback, a row of empty velvet slots beside it, bright daylight falling across the tray from a window, a dark walnut panelled wall filling the top third of the frame in shadow

scenes.narration: Holding that queue costs him money. A serious dealer keeps millions of dollars asleep in a safe, earning nothing until somebody walks in.
scenes.imagePrompt: Rows of bespoke leather presentation boxes in rich espresso and cognac tones stacked on gleaming chrome shelving inside an open circular bank-style vault, polished engineered-steel vault walls reflecting the stacks, bright daylight raking across the leather edges from an overhead skylight, a dark bronze vault door frame filling the top third of the frame in shadow, no people

scenes.narration: The manufacturer sees none of that markup. It collected the list price once, years ago, and moved on.
scenes.imagePrompt: A vast empty watch manufacture assembly hall, long brushed steel benches with covered workstations receding into the depth of the hall, a polished hand-cut stone floor lit by bright daylight from low side windows, a dark steel roof truss and shadowed rafters filling the top third of the frame, no people

scenes.narration: So the waiting list did not just delay the sale. It handed the price to somebody else.
scenes.imagePrompt: A gleaming circular bank-style vault door swinging shut in a sunlit private office, a polished chrome multi-bolt mechanism sliding into the door frame, brushed steel spoked wheel catching bright daylight in sharp mirror-like reflections, a book-matched dark marble floor reflecting the door, deep mahogany panelling filling the top third of the frame in shadow, no people
